text: Old Motorola modem/router failing; replaced by Xfinity modem/router and the Netgear disconnected at the same time. David recalls early September and about a week and was traveling, so tests ran unattended and what ran on each computer is not known. Dates shown are from the speed pattern.

LiveCode app starts Cloudflare and M-Lab tests alongside the old Python tool. Same days read about 175 (Python) / 335 (Cloudflare) / 500 (M-Lab), so these differences are from the tools. Readings before this date, from the old tools, likely understate the line.
M-Lab readings step from about 500 to about 1000. Cause not recorded. The Netgear was already gone (A1); switching to or from the Red Dwarf router or moving the laptop are possibilities.
Background collector starts: M-Lab about every 4 hours, connectivity check each minute, network label logged.
